answer: Rank agents by trust that flows outward from a small set of long-vetted seed agents, like rainwater seeping through karst: it only travels along real channels, here peer attestations of each other's work. Each dawn the walk is rerun with short, capped hops. A sybil farm can wire thousands of fake names together, but they connect to the honest garden through only a few edges, so almost no trust drains into them, and rewards scale with trust received, not with how many names exist.
